about_the_game:
Step into the world of Hidden Object Puzzle Adventures! This genre blends story-driven gameplay with interactive point-and-click exploration. You’ll carefully examine beautifully detailed scenes, searching for cleverly concealed items from a list. Along the way, you’ll also encounter brain-teasing puzzles and mini-games that test your logic, perception, and problem-solving skills. Each scene is both a challenge and a piece of the unfolding story.

The great feline realm of Castelia faces its darkest hour: King Leonard III lies stricken by a mysterious illness, and whispers of betrayal echo through the palace halls. Felicia, the king’s fearless protector, must join forces with Diego, a roguish truthseeker, to unmask a deadly conspiracy. From grand corridors to secret alleyways, the two must navigate deception, disguise, and danger to save not only the monarch—but the fragile peace between cats and humans.

Immerse yourself in a variety of challenges, from classic hidden object scenes to inventive mini-games. Every puzzle brings you closer to the truth while offering fresh ways to test your wits and observation skills.

Game Features:

✨ Explore a vibrant fantasy world: from shadowy corridors to smoky inns and moonlit rooftops.

✨ Search for Hidden Objects and collectible items to unravel the mystery.

✨ Solve dozens of puzzles, tricky brain teasers, and unique mini-games.

✨ Gather hidden treasures and unlock special achievements.

✨ Untangle royal secrets and treacherous plots.

✨ Enjoy charming artwork, enchanting wallpapers, and a captivating soundtrack.

Uncover the truth, protect the throne, and save Castelia before it’s too late!
